name: pixeloven
description: PixelOven's plugins for Claude Code and Codex — the agent foundation, the knowledge substrate, and the design system.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Portable agent methodology: 7 crew roles, planning/review/orchestration disciplines, onboarding, doctor and learn. Needs no platform; domain and stack skills ship as packs.

plugins.name: infra-skills
plugins.description: Crew skills pack: Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes (Kustomize, workloads, health sweeps) and GitHub Actions conventions, plus infrastructure seam detection and go-public review, with estate choices deferred to the project's local skills.

plugins.name: language-skills
plugins.description: Crew skills pack: language and toolchain conventions for coding agents, one skill per language, Python first.

plugins.name: planning-skills
plugins.description: Crew skills pack for product planning: idea shaping, requirements review, readiness, themes, story breakdown and cross-functional review. Drafts only; tracker sync optional.

plugins.name: identity-skills
plugins.description: Crew skills pack for identity and auth engineering: auth seams, flow tracing, surface mapping, signal reliability, account investigation and vendor config review.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Brand assets and design-system usage: the tokens, typography and component conventions a consuming project applies.

plugins.name: comfyui-docker
plugins.description: Authoring and operating a ComfyUI model store: comfy.yaml manifests, resolved locks, and the image channels that serve them.
